title: Audit Algernon: The Paperwork
description: Audit Algernon: The Paperwork — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Lieutenant

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Bring the first stack of receipts to the Townston Commander. He's just around the corner. Over there.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Audit Algernon

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Bring the first stack of receipts to the Townston Commander. He's just around the corner. Over there.

Offer:

Okay there, I stapled all of the receipts together all nice and neat. The Commander cannot stand to see messy paperwork. The last time I brought him a report, the staple was at forty degrees and not forty-five. The scene he made, well, I try not to think about it.

I need you to bring these all the way over to the Townston Commander and let him figure out what to do next. I would take them myself but an old war injury keeps me from walking around much.

Turn-in:

What is this?! More paperwork from the Lieutenant? He sure does love making it nice and neat, not too sure why though. Just let me look this over quickly and figure out our next step.

Objectives:

  • Collated Receipts ×1

Client level range: 7–20
